subject: MAP: HelixMed evaluation thresholds, stop-conditions, and acceptance test roadmap

Subject: MAP: HelixMed evaluation thresholds, stop-conditions, and acceptance test roadmap

John —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our conversation, attached is a concise Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that maps the pilot timeline to concrete success thresholds and the minimimum acceptance tests we recommend. The goal: a single artifact HelixMed can use to validate both accuracy and latency/cost tradeoffs during the two-week evaluation.

High-level highlights (see attached MAP_v1):
- Success signals: 95% intent-detection recall on the labelled subset; median inference latency < 220ms p50; token-cost within agreed budget.
- Stop-conditions: >5% classification drift on validation set OR sustained p95 latency > 800ms for more than 30m.
- Acceptance tests: 10k sample-run concordance report, edge-case scoring (top-20 failing prompts), and throughput smoke test at 100 req/min.

Ask: please review the attached MAP and the acceptance-test matrix. If HelixMed legal/procurement need different wording on data retention or audit logs, flag it and we’ll update the plan.

Next steps:
1) You confirm the two-week evaluation window and the internal SME list.
2) Procurement provides PO or procurement timeline so we can provision dedicated trial capacity.

Attaching: HelixMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP + timeline), acceptance-test-matrix.csv (test definitions), sample-data-subset.jsonl (anonymized).

Thanks,
Aditya Rao

If those three items are addressed, I can get the evaluation window scheduled for July 6–20.

John/Sarah/Procurement —

Following up with the requested artifacts and confirmed acceptance language. Summary below and attached one-pager + cost-sheet:

1) Cost & capacity
- Two-week dedicated trial estimate: $9,800 (A100-equivalent reserved pool); capped at $12,000 for the trial period. Detailed line items in attached cost-sheet.

2) Data & retention (legal language)
- Trial data: logs and KV-cache are ephemeral by default and will be purged 30 days after trial end unless HelixMed requests retention. No customer PII is exported in analytics reports by default. We confirm we can provide an audit log (read-only) for the trial period.

3) Dataset provenance and threshold rationale
- Thresholds were proposed from a 10k labelled sample of industry-standard clinical intake forms (anonymized). We’ll provide the blind sample and the script used for scoring so you can reproduce locally.

4) Acceptance test runbook (what success looks like)
- Concordance run: 10k golden prompts → must meet 95% intent recall and <= 8% top-1 label mismatch.
- Performance smoke: sustained 100 req/min throughput with median latency < 220ms.
- Edge-case triage: top-20 failing prompts documented + mitigation plan.

If that aligns, please confirm the July 6 start and we will provision capacity and share the test harness.

Attachments: HelixMed_MAP_v1.xlsx, acceptance-test-matrix.csv, sample-data-subset.jsonl, HelixMed_trial_costs.pdf

Thanks — looking forward to running this with you.
